meta.name: pyqt-db-adapter-layer
meta.description: Establish adapter and repository patterns for DB access in PyQt apps. Use when desktop app integrates with SQLite/MSSQL or similar stores.

copy.tagline: 为 PyQt 桌面应用建立数据库适配层与仓储模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在 PyQt 应用中需要结构化访问 SQLite 或 MSSQL 数据库
copy.tagline_en: Build database adapter and repository layers for PyQt desktop apps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need structured database access in PyQt apps with SQLite or MSSQL

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你为 PyQt 桌面应用建立数据库访问层，把数据操作和界面分开，并生成适配器、仓库、事务策略等代码。
howto.when: 当你开发 PyQt 桌面应用，需要连接 SQLite、MSSQL 等数据库时触发。

say.text: 帮我为这个 PyQt 应用生成数据库适配器和仓库层。
say.note: Claude 会读取协议并产出所需工件。

say.text: 添加事务策略和重试逻辑到数据库层。
say.note: Claude 会更新适配器/仓库边界。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you create a database access layer for PyQt desktop apps, separating data operations from UI, and generates adapters, repositories, transaction policies, etc.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you develop a PyQt desktop app that needs to connect to SQLite, MSSQL, or similar databases.

say_en.text: Generate database adapter and repository layer for this PyQt app.
say_en.note: Claude reads protocols and produces required artifacts.

say_en.text: Add transaction policy and retry logic to the database layer.
